detail.longDescription: I don't do new hobbies halfway. Baking, sewing, whatever it is—I'll disappear into inspiration boards, overbuy supplies, and find myself fully invested in a niche I joined only four hours ago. Unfortunately, that's when I hit a wall. Turns out enthusiasm and a can-do attitude only get you so far. Many businesses are approaching AI exactly like I approach a new hobby: all enthusiasm, shaky planning. And it's happening at scale.
